title: Drift is the single drawdown incident owner at the section 7.1 multiple and cites the causal metric event

ac1_telemetry_metric_event_ids.summary: RuntimeSummaryProjectionStore records {metric}_event_id (including drawdown_event_id and pnl_event_id) beside {metric}_at and {metric}_binding_id for non-derived metric updates when candidate_as_of >= previous_as_of; events that update a metric without an event_id drop any stale {metric}_event_id; out-of-order events and threshold-derived echo events (metadata.derived_from_threshold_evaluation is True) never move it; binding rollover clears {metric}_event_id.

ac2_drift_cites_causal_metric_event_id_f.summary: For a metric judged against an approved artifact baseline (baseline_source present), _scheduled_drift_report cites summary['{metric}_event_id'] as its single telemetry_event_id and never cites last_heartbeat_event_id; when the summary lacks {metric}_event_id or it equals last_heartbeat_event_id, the report fails closed (returns None).

ac3_drift_governed_125x_threshold_no_cop.summary: Reconciliation-drift reads rolling_drawdown_multiple (1.25x, comparator='gt') from services/evolution/config/threshold_sweep_thresholds.json via threshold_sweep_worker.load_thresholds() and evaluates it through threshold_sweep_worker._COMPARATORS with no copied constant. At or below 1.25x ([1.2x, 1.25x]) an approved-baseline drawdown warning stays observe-only; in (1.25x, 1.5x) it builds a governed DriftReport (severity='medium'); at or above 1.5x (relative_delta >= 0.5) the report stays critical.

ac4_incident_evidence_summary_and_evolut.summary: build_incident_from_drift_report includes threshold_metric, observed, comparator, threshold_value, threshold_window, and policy_source in IncidentCase.evidence_summary so services/evolution/sweep.py derives RETRAIN at LOW risk via unmodified ThresholdEvaluator for the (1.25x, 1.5x) medium band and keeps the existing critical FREEZE path at or above 1.5x.

ac5_threshold_sweep_skips_drift_owned_me.summary: threshold_sweep_thresholds.json marks rolling_drawdown_multiple with incident_owner='reconciliation-drift' (enabled=true). evaluate_breaches checks only explicit incident_owner=='reconciliation-drift' so it posts no incident and admits no derived telemetry event for that metric, while assess_input_coverage and GET /api/evolution/input-coverage still report the artifact evaluable.

ac6_documentation_single_producer.summary: EVOLUTION_REVIEW_AND_THRESHOLDS.md section 7.1 and services/reconciliation-drift/README.md document that reconciliation-drift is the single producer of the drawdown 1.25x incident with policy values unchanged.

ac7_tests_use_paper_runtime_emitter_and_.summary: Tests build telemetry events via RuntimeTelemetryEmitter (services/execution/lean_runtime/paper_runtime.py) and summaries via RuntimeSummaryProjectionStore (services/telemetry/runtime_summary.py), including negative cases for heartbeat-only summaries and derived echo events.

ac8_existing_incidents_and_decisions_unt.summary: No existing incidents or Evolution decisions were modified or deleted; CanonicalReferenceValidator and tests/{integration,unit}/l12 remain untouched.
